# ASDS Accelerate handoff capability fixture

This fixture mirrors the exact project-profile capability contract published by
the ASDS source adapter. Its authority is the ASDS source documentation and tests:

- `skills/spec-driven-superpowers/references/adapters/antigravity.md`
- `tests/agy-agent.test.js`

Accelerate copies this fixture only into isolated test workspaces. Production
markers and agent files remain ASDS-owned; Accelerate neither creates nor installs
them.
